s13dimaporo: Lanao del Norte Second District Rep. Abdullah Dimaporo was served an arrest warrant in a hospital in San Juan for malversation of public funds and graft involving alleged ghost projects valued at ₱5 million (punishable by more than 5 years) in 2004. … The Office of the Ombudsman indicted them last year … Dimaporo is requesting hospital detention since he suffered a mild heart attack a few days before the order for his arrest was issued last week. He is temporarily being allowed to stay at the Cardinal Santos Medical Center because of his medical condition, but he will be under tight watch by police and National Bureau of Investigation agents. The anti-graft court’s Fifth Division deferred ruling on Dimaporo’s petition for bail and motion to be placed under hospital detention since ombudsman prosecutors are opposing his requests. The Fifth Division chairman … directed the serving of the arrest warrant against Dimaporo at the hospital which allowed a court sheriff to take his fingerprints. The graft case is bailable in the amount of ₱30,000 which his lawyers paid. But the malversation of public funds charge … is non-bailable.
